_doc: Per-file char budgets for instructions/memory files (GHI #373). AGENTS.md was tightened 40k→15k by OBPI-0.0.54-01 as a moderate-compromise target; OBPI-0.0.54-03 measured a ~31k transitional floor with the current monolithic template. The budget ceiling was Codex's 32768-byte project-doc cap until the operator ruling of 2026-07-06 DECOUPLED it (hexagonal: an adapter limit must not gate the core contract); the ceiling is now _PROJECT_DOC_BUDGET_CEILING_BYTES = 65536, enforced by tests.governance.test_agents_md_map_doctrine._budget_within_ceiling. The vendor cap itself is observed, not enforced, by the surface-delivery witness under gz validate --instructions-files-budget (GHI #712) — it reports byte distance to stderr and fail-closes only on survival-declaration drift. 2026-06-04: OBPI-0.0.37-26 LANDED the interim #519 relief — the local splice (.gzkit/agents.local.md) was hand-compressed 9,306→4,997 bytes, dropping rendered root AGENTS.md to 28,342 bytes, under the then-30000 interim ceiling and ~4.4 KB under the Codex byte cap (genuine context reduction, not a budget-at-cap stopgap). This supersedes the transient budget-at-cap reading (32768) that only flipped the gate green without shrinking the surface. The committed rendition (renditions/agentcontract-codex-root-interim.md) is the durable payload OBPI-21/22's composer regenerates deterministically. The <15k destination remains GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37. 2026-06-22 (operator-ratified): AGENTS.md raised 30000→31000 to seat the corpus-faithful render of the full invariant-tier floor (all 45 entries verbatim render to 30,631 chars / 30,806 bytes). The prior 30000 ceiling could only be met by a rendition that DROPPED invariant entries — i.e. by drift — so the budget was holding the surface honest at the cost of the invariant floor. 31000 matches OBPI-0.0.54-03's measured transitional floor, fits the faithful render with headroom, and stays ~1.9 KB under the 32768 B Codex hard cap (no silent-truncation risk). The <15k destination via corpus splitting remains the durable goal (GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37). CLAUDE.md 4000 and .claude/rules/*.md 15000 remain from OBPI-0.0.54 AS OF THIS ENTRY (each dated entry states the values true on its own date, never the current ones — read the LAST entry for what is enforced today). 2026-06-30 (operator-directed, budget-tuning explicitly deferred — 'we will use that for tuning later, the mechanism to do so is now in place'): AGENTS.md raised 31000→31800 to seat the corpus-faithful render of 5 new invariant-tier guardrails captured from the 2026-06-30 insights report (pipeline-stage discipline, no --no-verify, narrow-scope discipline, defect/deferred-claim honesty, surface-blockers-upfront). Measured claude/root render = 31,569 bytes (invariant 9,612 / compressible 21,957); 31800 clears it whether counted as chars or bytes and holds ~968 B under the 32768 B Codex hard cap (no silent-truncation risk). This GROWS the surface against the <15k shrink goal (GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37) — the operator booked that tension as later tuning, not a blocker; the corpus-splitting destination is unchanged. 2026-07-06 (ceiling decoupled BY RULING; the three per-file BUDGETS moved UNWITNESSED in the same commit — backfilled here 2026-07-28): the operator ruling 'that hard-coded value is noise, bump' DECOUPLED the ceiling from the Codex vendor cap (32768→65536; hexagonal — an adapter limit must not gate the core contract), and that move is properly recorded. Riding in the same commit (219d23fd6, a `gz git-sync` chore bundle) were three BUDGET raises with no entry here and no rationale in the commit message: AGENTS.md 31800→50000, CLAUDE.md 4000→15000, .claude/rules/*.md 15000→30000. Ceiling and budget are different numbers; the ruling authorized the ceiling move only. Consequence: AGENTS.md slack went from 231 chars (0.7%, a gate that bound) to ~18k (56%, a gate that cannot fire), so the <15k destination (GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37) silently lost its only mechanical pressure — the drift class AGENTS.md § MAKE LLM STOCHASTIC VIBES INERT claim 3 names ('silent rule/threshold changes without a witness are the root failure'). Delivery note: `gz git-sync` bundles DERIVED surface regeneration and its commit template has no slot for 'why did this hand-tuned threshold change'; a value requiring rationale rode a ceremony that cannot carry one. 2026-07-28 (operator-directed reconciliation — 'reconcile the budget _doc against the enforced 50000', ruling: restore the gate): budgets retuned to just-above-measured so the gate binds again. Live measurement this date: AGENTS.md 32,023 chars / 32,208 B; CLAUDE.md 1,432 chars; largest rule file tests.md 17,851 chars. AGENTS.md 50000→33000 (977 chars / ~3% headroom — one invariant entry fits, a second forces a decision; the 2026-06-30 setting of 0.7% headroom is evidence AGAINST going tighter, since it was blown out within a week rather than forcing a shrink). CLAUDE.md 15000→4000 (restores the OBPI-0.0.54 value; the surface is a redirect stub by doctrine, so size is not its binding constraint). .claude/rules/*.md 30000→19000 — deliberately NOT back to 15000, which is no longer restorable: tests.md measures 17,851 and would fail closed on landing. Its rule-version-history preamble is the diet candidate that would let 15000 return; that is a separate shrink pass, not this reconciliation. Ceiling unchanged at 65536 (properly ruled 2026-07-06). The <15k destination via corpus splitting remains the durable goal (GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37).
